title: make repin cannot pin a sibling's local build
foundBy: user report (host): "it doesn't seem possible anymore to have make repin do pin on local builds, which haven't been published to ghcr.io or npmjs.com or built in the Github CI builds"

evidence.verified: dashboards' tests/test_repin_go.py passes all 7 of its tests against this same scripts/repin-go.sh. They pin and name a newer local build, and take CI's under `LOCAL=0`, when CI's is newer, and on a tie. They hold a build awaiting images, and skip one whose commit left the branch. In a scratch workspace, campaign's copy left out sandbox's newest local build once the sandbox checkout beside it held that commit on no branch. It said so, and took the build CI had made. GitHub CI's `ci` passed on 3b3e213, once the nested sandbox smoke job was run again: its microVM had stopped answering.

resolution: `make repin` now moves each cs- pin to the newer, by commit time, of the sibling's last CI build and its newest local build. It names each pin taken from a local build, and resolves those through the store's module proxy ahead of the usual one. `make repin LOCAL=0` takes CI builds only, and no module is fetched with `GOPROXY=direct` any more.
details: `make repin` moves each codesweep-ai tool pin to the first commit in `built` of its project's status file, and to nothing else. A build that a clean `make ci` recorded in the build store is invisible to it. So a change made across several projects cannot pin its own parts before they are pushed. Every module is also fetched with `GOPROXY=direct`. On a cold cache that reaches every module's source host, and it hung for over seven minutes where one did not answer.
